verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents a batch endpoint for ingesting usage events in bulk ("Ingest Usage Events in Batch") and asynchronous export jobs that return downloadable zip/pdf files of exported data, so bulk handling exists for specific resources. Nothing in the evidence shows general bulk create/update/cancel across subscriptions, customers, or invoices. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk mutation or import APIs across resource types, bulk actions via MCP or AI tooling, documented batch limits and error handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
